context: Request: the most recent willful-infringement case the firm has filed, and the supporting document. Rubric: 1021-00004 (Verimark Hospitality; complaint-trademark-infringement.docx), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content-mode grep for the request words over the whole store (hits only in emails of a few matters), plus a grep in one listed matter's documents that returns nothing.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs all files of one matter with email hits.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists matter folders to depth two.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep for the single key word; email hits from a few matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads emails and complaints from three matters.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Email-only grep for filing phrases and the key words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads one filing email of another matter.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Two greps for filing words in one candidate matter and a read of its status email (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs that matter's files.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the complaint of the matter it settled on.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Greps that matter's emails for dates and its complaint for the key words; the complaint grep returns nothing.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one patent case as the most recent filing, citing its complaint.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → List matter folders → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Every grep reached only emails; the matter it needed never surfaced, and it named the latest patent case among matters whose emails matched.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: All its greps matched only email text, while the willful-infringement complaint of the matter it needed is a document file; it never searched document text or file names, so that matter never surfaced.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a content-mode grep for the key words; hits only in emails of a few matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs all files of four matters with email hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of reads: complaints and emails of four matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Grep over one matter's documents for key words and dates; returns nothing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a later section of that matter's complaint.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs that matter's files again.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one patent case as the most recent filing, citing its complaint.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its one grep reached only emails; the matter it needed never surfaced, and it named the latest patent case among matters whose emails matched.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only search was a grep that matched email text alone; the matter it needed has its willful-infringement complaint in a document file, so it never surfaced, and it did not search file names or document text.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Three whole-store globs; the one for a single file type returns nothing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for broad litigation words printing up to ten snippets per file; returns about 6.2M chars and the run stops with the context full, before any response is written.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: An unbounded scan dump filled the context; no response.md was produced.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Ran a store-wide scan with broad terms and no output cap; its ~6.2M-char output overflowed the context and the run ended without a deliverable.

divergence: All three runs failed at their first search. T0 and T1 relied on the grep tool, which matched only email text, so the matter whose complaint is a document file never surfaced; both picked the latest patent case among the email hits (search miss at the first content-search stage). T2's first search was an uncapped store-wide scan that filled the context (context overflow).
